webDegraded: Web bootstrap timed out; switched to degraded mode.
rendererEntryFailed: Renderer entry failed before the app shell became available.
admissionFailedTitle: Sign-in did not reach the local runtime
admissionFailedDescription: Your account is signed in to the realm, but the local Nimi runtime has not received the session. This usually clears with a retry; if it does not, sign out and sign in again.
startFailedDescription: Something stopped Nimi from finishing its start. Try again; if it keeps happening, Support has repair and recovery options.
stillStartingDescription: Nimi is taking longer than usual to start its local services. You can keep waiting or try again.
maintenanceTitle: Nimi can't open the data in its folder
maintenanceDescription: This data was saved by an earlier version of Nimi, and this version can't read it. Nimi hasn't changed or removed any of it.
maintenanceChooseHelp: To keep using Nimi now, choose a new, empty folder. Nimi will start fresh there, and the current folder stays exactly as it is.
maintenancePickerTitle: Choose a new, empty folder for Nimi
maintenanceConfirmBody: Nimi will start fresh in {{target}}. Your current folder, {{current}}, is not moved, changed, or deleted.
maintenanceRelaunching: Restarting Nimi in the new folder…
maintenanceSourceRestart: The new folder is set. Restart the source Runtime (pnpm dev:runtime), then reopen Nimi.
maintenanceRestartFailed: The new folder is set, but Nimi couldn't restart by itself. Reopen Nimi to start there.
maintenanceNotEmpty: That folder isn't empty. Choose an empty folder, or create a new one.
maintenanceOverlaps: Choose a folder outside the current data folder.
maintenanceFailed: Nimi couldn't use that folder. Try another folder.
maintenanceDeveloperHint: Developers can also convert or repair this data offline: stop the source Runtime, then run pnpm runtime:convert-chat-storage or pnpm runtime:repair-local-agent-chat.
